children.innerHTML: Dentistry for people who'd rather be anywhere else
Gentle appointments that start on time, plans on paper before any work begins, and a numbing policy best described as generous.
4.9 from 600+ patients, several of them formerly terrified
Online or by phone. A real human confirms, and nobody puts you on hold with panpipe music.
Fifteen unhurried minutes: history, worries, coffee habits. Confession is good for the molars.
Photos, findings and fees printed and explained. You take it home. No decisions in the chair.
Treatment booked when you're ready. Numb first, check twice, music of your choosing.
The usual suspects, done unusually carefully
The full once-over, x-rays when needed, and a polish that squeaks.
Custom trays, honest expectations, zero disco-white surprises.
Straighter teeth without the metal. Checked monthly by a human.
Tooth-coloured, matched to your enamel, built to be forgotten.
A missing tooth replaced properly, planned in 3D before we begin.
In pain now? Slots held open every single day. Call before 10am.
Half our patients arrived as self-declared dental cowards. We go at your pace: hand signals that actually stop the drill, breaks whenever, and nothing sprung on you mid-appointment.
First visit can be talk-only. Chair optional.
Raise a hand, everything stops. Every time.
Headphones, your playlist, our terrible taste quarantined.
Reviews we didn't have to beg for
“Twenty years of avoiding dentists, undone in one appointment. I dozed off during a filling. Dozed. Off.”
“They talked me out of veneers I didn't need. A business actively refusing my money. Extraordinary.”
“My six-year-old asks when she gets to go back. I don't fully understand it either.”
Check-ups from $95. Next-day slots most weekdays. Nervous patients our speciality.
